landing.description: A hyperlocal platform where parents and caregivers connect, coordinate, and support each other — because no one should have to do this alone.
landing.organizedByCommunityDesc: Join your school or neighborhood parent community. Connect with other caregivers nearby, share resources, and show up for each other.
landing.organizedByCommunityDetail: Each community has its own dedicated space, making it easy for parents and caregivers to coordinate, share resources, and build the connections that make parenting a little easier.
landing.directMessagesDesc: Chat privately with other parents, coordinate carpools, and plan playdates — all in one place.
landing.classroomGroupsDesc: Stay connected with your child's class. Coordinate snack schedules, field trips, and volunteer sign-ups with ease.
landing.mutualAidPostsDesc: Post a need or offer support to other parents in your community. No judgment — just neighbors helping neighbors.
landing.safeAndPrivateDesc: Verified members only. Your family's information stays private.
landing.hyperlocalDesc: Connected to the parents and caregivers in your school and neighborhood.
landing.alwaysFreeDesc: No ads, no fees. Built for families, not profit.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to find your parent community
landing.step1Desc: Sign up and find your school or neighborhood. Connect with other parents and caregivers near you.
landing.step2Desc: Find your child's teacher and grade. Join classroom groups to stay in the loop and coordinate with other parents.
landing.step3Desc: Ask for help, offer what you can, and build the village your family deserves.
landing.roomParentsDesc: Coordinate class events, organize volunteers, and keep parents in the loop on classroom needs.
landing.carpoolsDesc: Find families nearby to share pickup and dropoff duties, after-school activities, and weekend sports.
landing.classroomSuppliesDesc: Share school supplies, books, and materials with families who need them. Every child deserves what they need to learn.
landing.eventsDesc: Organize fundraisers, coordinate field trip volunteers, and plan class celebrations together.
landing.childcareSwapsDesc: Trade babysitting hours with trusted parents from your community. Reliable childcare shouldn't be out of reach.
landing.familySupportDesc: Reach out when you need a hand, or step up for a family going through a hard time. That's what community is for.
landing.mutualAidPrinciplesDesc: This isn't charity — it's community. Parents and caregivers supporting each other as equals, because we're all in this together.
landing.equalDesc: No hierarchy. Every parent gives and receives. Both matter.
landing.reciprocalDesc: Support flows both ways. Every caregiver has something to offer.
landing.communityLedDesc: Built by parents, for parents. No corporate agenda — just community.
landing.readyToFindDesc: Join your parent community today. It's free, always.
landing.footerTagline: Connecting parents and caregivers through community.
landing.copyright: © 2025 The Village. Built with ❤️ for parents and caregivers everywhere.

about.title: About The Village
about.subtitle: A community built by parents and caregivers, for parents and caregivers — because raising children is better together.
about.missionText1: The Village is a hyperlocal platform designed for parents and caregivers who want to feel less alone. Whether you're navigating school pickups, looking for childcare support, or just need a neighbor to lean on — we connect you with the parents and caregivers right in your community.
about.missionText2: Built on the principles of mutual aid, our platform creates spaces where parents help each other as equals — sharing rides, swapping childcare, coordinating school events, and building the deep bonds that make parenting feel a little less overwhelming.
about.whyMutualAidText1: Mutual aid is voluntary, reciprocal support for shared benefit. For parents and caregivers, it means showing up for each other as equals — because every family has something to give, and every family sometimes needs a hand.
about.whyMutualAidText2: Instead of going it alone, mutual aid builds networks where parents contribute what they can and receive what they need. The parent who drives carpool today might need a last-minute babysitter next week. The caregiver organizing the class party this month might be the one asking for meal support next month.
about.reciprocalDesc: Everyone gives and receives. Today's helper is tomorrow's recipient.
about.equalDesc: No hierarchy — just parents and caregivers supporting each other.
about.empoweringDesc: Building resilient parent communities that grow stronger over time.
about.sustainableDesc: Long-term relationships rooted in trust and shared experience.
about.communityCenteredDesc: Organized around your school or neighborhood, so you connect with the parents and caregivers you actually see — at drop-off, at the park, or on the sidelines.
about.hyperlocalDesc: Built for your immediate community. The strongest support networks start with the parents and caregivers closest to you.
about.privacyFirstDesc: Your family's data is yours. We don't sell your information, track you across the web, or share details with third parties.
about.communityLedDesc: Built by parents, for parents. Your feedback shapes how this platform grows to serve your family and your community.
about.alwaysFreeDesc: No premium tiers, no hidden fees. Support for parents and caregivers should be accessible to every family.
about.leadCompassionDesc: Every parent and caregiver is doing their best. We assume good intentions and offer grace — especially on the hard days.
about.celebrateDiversityDesc: All families, backgrounds, identities, abilities, and beliefs are welcome here. Our communities are stronger when every caregiver belongs.
about.communicateClearlyDesc: Be honest, direct, and follow through. Reliable communication is what makes parent communities actually work.
about.keepSafeDesc: Respect boundaries, protect privacy, and put the safety of children and families first. Always.
about.shareGenerouslyDesc: Contribute what you can, when you can. No contribution is too small — every parent has something valuable to offer.
